name: Play a free untapped land that unlocks a hand card on turn 1-2
intent: On turn 1 or 2, before anything else about the land drop is decided, play a land from hand that already enters untapped and makes some other hand card payable that is not payable now - a Plains that lets Serra Ascendant be cast. This never costs life and never asks the fetch machinery to run, so it goes first: a land this good is never worse than holding it. Prefers a basic first, since orzhov-martyr's own duals and utility lands are never scarcer to hold onto than a basic. Only turns 1-2, only with the land drop still available, and only mine, precombat main, an empty stack. Does not ask about a fetch (open-fetch-unlocks-basic); that needs a search and ranks below this. This deck runs no open-shock-unlocks play at all - see open-fetch-unlocks-basic's own intent for why paying life is avoided here.
